fidelity: F2a — FT Chain-Growth Kinetics + Lumped Reactor Thermal ODE
description: Physics-lumped Fischer-Tropsch (Co/Al2O3 LTFT) reactor for Power-to-Liquid synthetic kerosene. Langmuir-Hinshelwood CO-consumption kinetics, Anderson-Schulz-Flory chain-growth tuned for jet-range (C8-C16) selectivity, wax hydrocracking to the jet cut, and a lumped exothermic reactor energy balance integrated with scipy.solve_ivp. Reports jet-fuel yield/selectivity, CO conversion, reactor temperature, and overall power-to-liquid efficiency including the electrolysis/RWGS upstream context.
source: Schmidt et al. (2018) 'Power-to-Liquids as Renewable Fuel Option for Aviation', Chem. Ing. Tech. 90(1-2), 127-140; De Klerk, A. (2011) 'Fischer-Tropsch Refining', Wiley-VCH; Dry, M.E. (2002) Catalysis Today 71, 227-241; Yates & Satterfield (1991) Energy & Fuels 5, 168-173; Anderson (1956); Schulz (1999) Appl. Catal. A 186, 3-12.

unit.name: Generic LTFT Co/Al2O3 Slurry Reactor for PtL Jet Fuel, 200-230 degC, 20-30 bar

T_opt.note: Optimal LTFT reactor temperature (Co catalyst 200-230 C, Dry 2002)

k0_FT.note: Arrhenius pre-exponential for Yates-Satterfield LH FT CO-consumption rate, calibrated so per-pass X_CO~0.8 at T_opt design point (Yates & Satterfield 1991; Dry 2002)

Ea_FT.note: FT apparent activation energy (Co catalyst ~80-110 kJ/mol, Yates & Satterfield 1991)

K_ads.note: Yates-Satterfield CO adsorption constant a/b in r=a*P_H2*P_CO/(1+b*P_CO)^2

m_cat.note: Catalyst loading in lumped slurry reactor

alpha_ASF.note: ASF chain-growth probability at T_opt (LTFT Co: 0.85-0.92, high C5+)

dalpha_dT.note: Chain-growth probability decreases with temperature (HTFT lowers alpha, Dry 2002)

wax_to_jet_frac.note: Fraction of C16+ wax recovered into jet cut by mild hydrocracking (De Klerk 2011: hydrocracker jet yield ~0.6-0.8)

n_CO_in.note: Default CO feed rate to FT reactor

P_CO.note: CO partial pressure at reactor inlet

P_H2.note: H2 partial pressure at reactor inlet (~2.1x CO)

LHV_FT_kJ_mol.note: LHV per mol C12 surrogate jet fuel (~44 MJ/kg)

MW_jet.note: Molar mass of C12 surrogate jet fuel (kerosene avg)

C_per_jet.note: Carbon atoms per jet-fuel surrogate molecule (C12)

eta_electrolysis.note: PEM electrolysis LHV efficiency for upstream H2 (Schmidt 2018)

DH_reaction.note: FT exotherm per mol CO converted (Dry 2002, Table 1)

m_reactor.note: Lumped thermal mass of slurry reactor + inventory

cp_reactor.note: Effective specific heat of slurry (paraffin wax/oil dominated)
